title: Practice 10: Where: над, под, за, перед, между

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Дети играют под ___ (лаймовое дерево).
exercises.prompt: The children are playing under the lime tree.
exercises.why: «под» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Конюхи ухаживают за ___ (лошади).
exercises.prompt: The grooms tend to the horses.
exercises.why: «за» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Перед ___ (нанесение) второго слоя убедитесь, что первый слой высох.
exercises.prompt: Make sure that the first coat is dry before applying the second coat.

exercises.q: Связь между ___ (эпилепсия) и метаболизмом глюкозы была подтверждена более 85 лет назад.
exercises.prompt: The relationship between epilepsy and glucose metabolism was established more than 85 years ago.
exercises.why: «между» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Individual genes specify individual functions, but the relationship between genes enables physiology.

exercises.q: Вильгельм Завоеватель одержал победу над ___ (король) Гарольдом в битве при Гастингсе в 1066 году.

exercises.why: «над» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
